page: Amazon Web Services i4i.32xlarge is a storage-optimized server instance built on the Nitro hypervisor. It features 128 vCPUs derived from 64 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8375C processor running at 3.5 GHz. The x86_64 architecture includes 1024.0 GB of DDR4 memory operating at 3 GHz, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per physical core. A key hardware feature is the inclusion of 30,000 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, alongside a baseline network bandwidth of 75 Gbps. No GPUs are present on this instance type.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core and memory performance. The instance achieved a top-tier rating in the Passmark CPU score of 86,632.57 and the Passmark CPU encryption test of 110,454.76. Multi-core stress-ng CPU performance and Geekbench multi-core scores are rated as strong, reflecting the high core density. Memory bandwidth tests show strong read-only performance at 333.72 GB/sec for large blocks and 6,624.97 GB/sec for cached small blocks. Database operations are supported by strong Redis SET performance at 104.77 million operations per second and a strong Passmark database operations score.

While the instance excels in multi-threaded tasks, single-core performance is average, as shown by stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core benchmarks. In terms of machine learning workloads, prompt processing for small and medium LLMs is strong, but text generation for large 70B models is weak at 2.78 tokens per second due to the lack of dedicated GPU acceleration. Given the massive local NVMe storage capacity, high memory density, and strong multi-threaded capabilities, this instance is suited for large-scale databases, data warehousing, transactional databases, and high-throughput web serving.
